newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU adds $43 million to mad cow research funds.
newsitem.headline: EU adds $43 million to mad cow research funds.

text.p: European Union research ministers agreed on Thursday to add $43 million to the funds available for research into fatal brain-wasting diseases such as mad cow disease and its human equivalent.

The extra funds, still to be cleared by the European Parliament, are part of a package of extra cash worth 100 million European currency units ($124 million) for projects related to multimedia software for education, land mine destruction, water, environment, aerospace and transport.

Research into mad-cow-type diseases became a priority for the EU after British scientists last March raised the possibility that humans could develop the human equivalent of bovine spongifoprm encephalopathy (BSE) by eating infected beef.
The revelation led to a world-wide ban on beef and derived products from Britain, where 165,000 cattle have developed BSE during the last 10 years.

"I have no doubt that news of new, additional funding for research on this important topic will be welcomed by consumer, agriculture and health interests and will also act to restore consumer confidence," Irish Research Minister Pat Rabbitte told a news conference after the meeting. ($=0.81 Ecus)
